description: This file contains utility methods for AWS SDK, specifically for DynamoDB operations such as region endpoint retrieval and key validation, with conditional namespace definitions based on compilation symbols.

classes.name: AWSUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for AWS SDK operations, including region endpoint retrieval and DynamoDB key validation.

methods.name: GetRegionEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the AWS RegionEndpoint based on the provided zone string, defaults to USWest2 if not found.

methods.name: ValidateDynamoDBPartitionKey
methods.description: Validates the length of a DynamoDB partition key, throws ArgumentException if too long.

methods.name: ValidateDynamoDBRowKey
methods.description: Validates the length of a DynamoDB row key, throws ArgumentException if too long.
